coverage.note: Curated official AFC team news is primary. Provider injuries are optional and are not team news. No adverse entry means available by default, not a verified fit. Contradicted claims are shown in the review block.

availability.note: Availability is a special case of team news. Only a verified curated entry changes the predicted XI; a provider signal alone does not. Contradicted claims become unknown and stay visible in the review block. Context-only names without an official public source are held in a private verification queue and are not published.

case.note: The record is derived from local match, squad, history and transfer data. Missing layers are labelled; they are never zero.

cups.name: Premier Sports Cup
cups.note: The licensed feed supplies all 80 group matches and the knockout ties, including penalty shoot-outs. Group standings are not provided; the app computes the eight group tables. Group letters are assigned by the app from the fixture graph because the feed does not expose the official draw letters.

cups.name: Scottish Gas Men's Scottish Cup
cups.note: The licensed feed covers 70 of 136 ties (First Round, Second Round, Third Round). Rounds not provided: Preliminary Round One, Preliminary Round Two, Preliminary Round Three, Fourth Round, Fifth Round, Quarter-final, Semi-final, Final. The page labels the gap rather than inventing ties.

fixtures.note: One page per played Cormack-era fixture; depth is the data actually available.

former_players.note: The register covers 2019-20 onward. Post-career league seasons are measured where the provider covers them; missing seasons are gaps, not zero. Cup and European provider rows are excluded from totals because some repeat league totals. Ratings are league-relative.

forum.note: Sampled first pages of recent Rumour Mill topics. This is not the whole thread, the whole forum or the fanbase. No raw post bodies, usernames or quotes are published, and the text is not used for AI training.

history.note: Manager records are league-only. Pre-2024-25 transfer windows are curated partial. Selection depends on the historical lineup backfill.

matchday.note: Form and style are league-only and opponent-unadjusted. Predicted XIs are projections from observed lineups, not team news. Possession is not used.

needs.note: Needs are role profiles, not transfer targets. The curated prior is shown separately and is not blended into a verdict.

summary.note: Role profiles and market routes only. No targets, fees or wages.

provenance.note: A source is listed as primary only for the layers it actually supplies. Row counts are primary contributions only; curated and derived layers are labelled as such.

rumours.note: A curated register of Aberdeen-linked rumours, separate from the confirmed transfer register. Status is a lifecycle label, not a probability. Confidence is editorial and must be justified by the linked sources. Confirmed rows link to the transfer register and are then a historical record, not a second source of truth.

squad.note: Current-season squad and per-competition statistics from API-Football. Roles come from the starting-XI formation grid; starts, substitute appearances and on-pitch minutes are reconstructed from lineups and substitution events. The official AFC men's team page is the canonical roster inclusion, section, order and loan-section source; API-Football supplies statistics and identity. API rows not on the official list are not squad players and are excluded from these counts; they are retained only for the player index and existing links. Missing data is labelled unavailable or partial and is never filled with zeroes. Player photographs are not published.

transfers.note: Confirmed business only. The recent four windows are audited against a seniority review; earlier windows are curated partial. Rows are curated from the licensed API-Football candidate feed and Wikipedia season tables; an official AFC announcement is linked where found. Fees are not in the feed. Disclosed/reported fees are kept as anchors; undisclosed permanent moves carry an inferred range, not a claimed amount. Free transfers count as zero fee; loan fees are excluded. Loan end, recall and obligation terms are unknown unless confirmed.

xg.note: fxG needs shots on target. Missing provider team statistics are shown as unavailable, not zero.
